_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ {num_players}-player Liar's Dice agorɔ mu.
Mmara:
- Wɔ wo turn, wo betumi ayɛ:
  1) Yɛ bid foforɔ a ɛwɔ quantity kɛseɛ anaa face kɛseɛ (anaa ne nyinaa) sen sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Frɛ last bid no denam '[Call]'.

Sɛ wo frɛ a:
  - Sɛ actual count no nkyɛ face value no wɔ dice nyinaa mu no yɛ kɔm deɛ bid no, last bidder no hwɛ die baako.
  - Sɛ ɛnteɛ a, caller no hwɛ die baako.
Player a ɔhwɛ die 0 no pɛ agorɔ no.

board.new_round:
Round foforɔ - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Wo Dice a ɛteɛ ne: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} frɛe! Actual count no nkyɛ face {face_value} no yɛ {count}, a ɛyɛ kɔm deɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (last bidder) hwɛ die baako.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} frɛe! Actual count no nkyɛ face {face_value} no yɛ {count}, a ɛnteɛ kɔm deɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (caller) hwɛ die baako.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ɔfrɛ a wɔfrɛɛ no bere a na wɔntua sika biara.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action a wɔankyerɛw sɛ '[Bid: X, Y]' anaa '[Call]'. Action a wɔde too: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Nananom foforo {new_quantity} no so sene seesei de a wɔtɔ ase {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: New face value {new_face_value} yɛ ketewa kyɛn current {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Nvasoɛ ne le ko nee mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ɛnɛ la.
bid_reason.face_range: Ɛsɛ sɛ ne din no yɛ 1 kosi 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} no de ne nsa too fam wɔ mmirika a ɛmfata mu.
